text:
Mia Chen: heads up — noticed a bunch of high-latency tail traces are getting dropped by our current head-based sampler. links to logs next
Raj Patel: any particular route or customer? or random spike?
Mia Chen: mostly /v1/generate and a few enterprise tenants. pattern: long-running streams, retries, and the error rate for those sampled looks off
Olive Park: sounds like classic tail sampling problem. head sampling favors short fast requests and misses the slow/error ones
Mia Chen: yep. thinking hybrid: default head sampling at 0.5% but keep a reservoir for tail/error traces per route/customer-tier. dynamic adjustments by QPS
Raj Patel: +1. We should be able to deterministically sample by (customer_id, route) hash for low variance and to rebuild sessions
Raj Patel: also need to stash full traces for anomalies (rare) — maybe export only on error flag or latency > 2s
Kim Le: cost/retention is the kicker. We can't keep full traces for free. How big would the reservoir be?
Mia Chen: proposal sketch:

```
# pseudo
if span.has_error or span.latency_ms > 2000:
  sample = true
else:
  sample = deterministic_hash(customer_id, route) < route_tier_rate
```

+ reservoir: fixed-size per route to keep recent 100 slow traces (LRU)
Raj Patel: add jittered probability for burst protection. And we should tag sampled traces with sampling_key so dashboards can reweight
Olive Park: agree. For OTEL: use tail-sampling processor on collector + a small exporter that writes full traces to S3/ClickHouse and sends sampled pointers to Honeycomb
Kim Le: retention tiers by customer contract — enterprise gets 30d, free gets 3d; adjust exporter TTL accordingly
Mia Chen: UX question — how do we expose sampling config in console? per-route sliders + preset by tier? Also a "snapshot" toggle to request full traces for a tenant temporarily
Raj Patel: UI: per-route JSON policy with quick presets (low/med/high). Audit log of changes
Sam (deploy-bot): canary rollout scheduled: telemetry/sampler v2 will go to canary 10% at 2025-11-14T03:20Z
Mia Chen: next steps: draft PR with collector config + pseudocode + cost estimate. Assign me +@Raj to implement deterministic hash + dashboard hooks
Kim Le: also add eval: compare sampled error rate vs ground truth on small test fleet for 24h
Olive Park: I'll mock the dashboards and a dashboard to show sampling bias metrics (:bar_chart:)
Raj Patel: cool. I'll start the OTEL collector config and add smoke tests
Mia Chen: thanks. syncing with product after PR
